title: So 2025
description: Kid-3 enthusiastically repeats “6-7,” but Kid-2 tells her the phrase was already old news in 2025.
alt: In the back seat of a car, Kid-3 sits securely buckled in a child car seat while a cream-colored stuffed bunny sits on the seat beside her. Kid-3 says, “6-7!” Kid-2 sits beside her wearing a seat belt and replies, “6-7? That was so 2025.”
